import { Cluster, Menu, Select } from "@hackcove/ui-react";

export const view = (edit: () => void, items: string[]) => (
  <Cluster as="ul">
    <li key="menu">
      <Menu label="Actions" items={[{ label: "Edit", onSelect: edit }]} />
    </li>
    <li key="pick">
      <Select<string> label="Pick" items={items} />
    </li>
  </Cluster>
);
